title: Mackerel and beetroot salad
summary: Mackerel and beetroot salad is a mediterranean dinner built around mackerel fillets and cooked beetroot, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook mackerel fillets for Mackerel and beetroot salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm rocket alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss cooked beetroot with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Mackerel and beetroot salad straight away. Taste Mackerel and beetroot salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
